answer.reason: The verses on Solomon's temple state two chief events of this place: its gold overlay and the ark being brought into it.

clauses.quote: he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents

clauses.english: received the ark of the covenant of the LORD under the wings of the cherubims
clauses.quote: to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims

doubts: The record is typed as an altar, but the verses concern the inner room of the temple. I wrote about the room and left out the gilded altar of 1KI 6:22.
I left out EZK 41, 44, 45 and 48, DAN 9:24, PSA 28:2 and HEB 9-10 because they give measurements, rules, a vision, or refer to a different or figurative sanctuary, not an event of Solomon's room.
